sylhet-2022.interpretation_warning: Candidate gains and losses are exploratory Sentinel-1 backscatter transitions, not confirmed flood extent. GFM is a satellite-derived reference, not independent ground truth. ALOS-2 polygons are positive detections only; the ALOS-2 observation footprint has not been independently verified. ML predictions were trained on GFM-derived labels and are not independently validated flood extent. Candidate transition areas use common-valid observations and differ from the strict GFM evaluation area.
